review_description: The total outlay for the 1.5Kw system was $3,145.00. The quote from Macquarie Valley Solar was $900.00 cheaper than the nearest quote. I finally decided to go with Macquarie Valley Solar because of the cost and also because they were based in my home town of Wellington NSW.

I obtained 4 quotes from companies in Dubbo, Orange & Wellington and found them all to be very cooperative and willing to provide all information requested so that I could make an informed decision on which company to select. I selected a 2.5kW system as recommended and the prices ranged from $4600 to $6300.
